pair_probe: up to 32 exact-request state-change pairs and 32 exact-context request-variant pairs, one pair per group, sampled from the strict test partition before inference
adaptation: LoRA query and value projections, rank 8, alpha 16, dropout 0.05; frozen pretrained weights
checkpoint_selection: highest validation macro-F1, then lowest validation target-token loss
prediction: maximum summed conditional log probability of a complete canonical label and end token
primary_metric: macro-F1 on the same label-balanced held-out sample before and after training
additional_metrics: accuracy, per-label F1, both-correct state pairs, exact-context request variants, instruction-only ablation
inference_policy: identical candidate labels, prompt template, tokenizer, and inference rule before and after tuning
scope: supervised transfer for one compact pretrained instruction model on a simulated compliance contract; no claim of live dispatch or executable-control improvement
resource_policy: local MPS or CPU; at most 8 CPU threads; retain small adapter checkpoints only
